text:
Evan (Sales): Heads-up — MercuryBank trial kickoff next week. Need a quick map of deliverables and who owns each integration piece. Can we lock owners + any blockers by EOD?

Jess (SE): I'll own the connector validation and acceptance tests. Will post the test plan shortly. @Rahul any infra caveats for VPC peering? :eyes:

Rahul (Engineering): Short answer: yes. Need a dedicated VPC endpoint and firewall rule for their egress IPs. Also we should confirm whether they want mutual TLS for our private deployment. I can spin up a draft terraform snippet.

Camille (Solutions): Mercury asked for a soft-SLA for latency on chat completions (95th < 400ms) and an audit log export for the first 30 days. Who owns the audit export?

Jess (SE): I can wire the audit export config with our Console routes, but need a list of fields they require. Camille — can you share the schema or example?

Camille (Solutions): sending sample schema in the docs link: https://redwood.work/docs/mercurybank-audit-schema — also they need sample events for token auth flows.

Rahul (Engineering): For the mTLS/peering bit, blocking items: (1) Mercury to provide ASN + BGP details if they want direct connect. (2) Security approval for mutual TLS — I'll raise a quick sec ticket. Otherwise basic VPC peering + firewall is fine. ETA: can have terraform + sample firewall rules by tomorrow EOD.

Evan (Sales): Great. Rollup of owners so far: connector tests & acceptance: Jess. Infra/VPC + terraform: Rahul. Audit export wiring: Jess (with schema from Camille). Anything missing?

Jess (SE): We also need a data retention/PII checklist for their telemetry. I'll add that to the test plan and tag legal if needed.

Camille (Solutions): Confirmed Mercury will provide a staging tenant and API key by Monday. Also asked about example prompt templates — they want defaults that preserve redaction for account numbers.

Rahul (Engineering): One more: config change to enable KV prefix caching for their workload. @Jess can you review my small config PR? Link: https://git.redwood/infra/mercury/PR-402

Jess (SE): On it — I'll do a CR pass tonight and drop comments. If it's small we can merge and schedule a canary deploy. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary deploy for "mercury-trial" config on staging at 2024-02-12T02:30:00Z. Notified eng-oncall.

Evan (Sales): Success criteria checklist for the trial (so we all agree):
- Connector passes acceptance tests (owner: Jess)
- Latency SLO met on 95th (owner: Rahul)
- Audit logs exported and validated (owner: Jess)
- SMOKE user flows verified with staging tenant (owner: Camille)

Camille (Solutions): I'll coordinate the smoke runs and post results in this thread.

Jess (SE): Created the acceptance test doc: https://redwood.work/acceptance/mercurybot-tests — checklist + runbook. Added test owner matrix.

Rahul (Engineering): I've opened infra ticket INF-2893 for VPC peering + firewall rules. Adding specifics there. Will update here when terraform is ready.

Evan (Sales): Thanks team. If owners can drop quick statuses by EOD so I can update Mercury with a concrete plan, that'd be ideal.

Jess (SE): Status: test plan drafted, waiting on schema from Camille.

Rahul (Engineering): Status: terraform draft in progress, sec ticket opened. ETA tomorrow EOD.

Camille (Solutions): Status: staging tenant + API key expected Monday, will confirm once we have it.

Evan (Sales): Perfect. I'll compile and send to Mercury. :rocket:

Jess (SE): tagging @deploy-bot once PR merged to trigger canary.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Will run canary pipeline after PR merge and report back to this thread.

Evan (Sales): Closing loop for now — reopening if any blockers pop up. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
